inputs.text: Phoenix leaders are using the Wednesday-night vote to make control over federal immigration enforcement—and the public’s view of it—look like ordinary oversight. The accountability talk is cover: whoever decides where enforcement can operate also gets leverage over the story. That kind of managed transparency is a reason to be wary, not reassured.
